title: Trello
description: Trello is a project management brand whose multi-color status palette includes blue (#0079bf), lime (#70b500), bright orange (#ff9f1a), red (#eb5a46), bright amber (#f2d600), soft purple (#c377e0), soft pink (#ff78cb), bright cyan (#00c2e0), green (#51e898), and light gray (#c4c9cc).
